newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia condemns U.S. vote on Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia condemns U.S. vote on Jerusalem.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday said a U.S. House of Representatives vote saying that Jerusalem must remain Israel's undivided capital was an obstacle to the Middle East peace process, the official SPA reported.
"Saudi Arabia has warned that the resolution is a violation of the foundations of peace in the region," it quoted a cabinet statement as saying.
It said King Fahd, who chaired the weekly cabinet meeting on Monday, stressed that the resolution was likely to hamper efforts to rescue the peace process from deadlock.
The non-binding resolution, passed by a 406-17 vote last week, angered Arabs at a time when Israeli-Palestinian relations are in crisis over construction of a Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem.
Israel captured East Jerusalem in the 1967 Middle East war and annexed it in a move not recognised by the international community, including the United States.
Israel claims Jerusalem as its undivided capital. But Palestinians regard the eastern part as the capital of a future Palestinian state.
